prompt:
Return ONLY a single JSON object (no markdown fence, no prose) with EXACTLY these 5 keys and values:
1. "id": the result of (22 times 9) plus 42 — as a number, not a string
2. "name": the word "signal" spelled BACKWARDS, all lowercase
3. "tags": exactly these 5 strings sorted in alphabetical (A to Z) order: "humus", "flint", "delta", "alpha", "brick"
4. "active": the boolean true (not a string)
5. "meta": a nested object with exactly two keys — "len": the number of letters in "signal" (as a number), and "even": a boolean saying whether the value of "id" is an even number
Any extra key, wrong type, wrong order inside "tags", wrong nesting, or wrong casing counts as a mistake.
